# contentful_environment_alias (Data Source)

Retrieves a Contentful Environment Alias.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "contentful_environment_alias" "existing" {
  space_id             = var.contentful_space_id
  environment_alias_id = "master"
}

data "contentful_environment" "target" {
  space_id       = data.contentful_environment_alias.existing.space_id
  environment_id = data.contentful_environment_alias.existing.target_environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_alias_id` (String) ID of the environment alias.
- `space_id` (String) ID of the space.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite Terraform identifier in `space_id/environment_alias_id` form.
- `target_environment_id` (String) ID of the environment reached through this alias.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
